verify.description: Run the full self-check for this style-guide repo (Biome + typecheck)
verify.prompt:
Verify that the guide's own code is clean and type-correct before committing.

Run, in order, and report any failures:

1. Run `bun run check:ci` at the repo root (covers `shared/` except `shared/config/`; `templates/` has its own configs) — must pass with no errors.
2. Run `bun run typecheck` (runs `tsc -p ./tsconfig.json`) — must print 'Typecheck passed!'.
3. For every template that changed: inside that template run `bun install`, `bun run check:ci`, `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` (Nuxt templates: also `bun run build` or `bun run generate`). Known upstream typecheck failures in generated `app/api-client/` files are acceptable; report them separately. Note that under Bun `nuxt typecheck` does not check `.vue` files.
4. If a template file that has a copy in `shared/` changed, confirm the `shared/` copy matches.

Do not commit. Just report a concise pass/fail summary per step with the failing output if any.

typecheck.description: Type-check the guide's shared utilities with tsc
typecheck.prompt: Run `bun run typecheck` for this repository and report the result. If it fails, show the first few TypeScript errors with file:line and suggest the fix. Do not edit files unless asked.

format.prompt: Run `bun run format` at the repo root, then `bun run check:ci` to confirm there are no remaining issues. For a template, run the same two scripts inside the template directory. Report a concise summary of what changed and any findings that need manual attention.

test.prompt: Run `bun run test` for this repository (templates are excluded via --path-ignore-patterns). Report pass/fail status and any failures with the exact command that was run.
